name.security_impact: If naming is not consistent, it becomes hard to manage or track policies in GCP.
name.rationale: We enforce a simple naming rule (pde-*) so all policies follow the same pattern and are easy to identify.

parent.description: The resource where this policy is attached.
parent.security_impact: If parent is wrong, policy may be applied to the wrong project or not applied at all.
parent.rationale: Parent must always be a valid GCP project or organization path so the policy applies correctly.

rules.description: Rules that define what resources and permissions are allowed.
rules.security_impact: Rules control access. Wrong rules can give too much access or block needed access.
rules.rationale: We use rules to enforce least privilege and limit access only to required resources.

display_name.description: A simple name shown in the console.
display_name.security_impact: Helps identify policies easily in UI.
display_name.rationale: Used for readability and easier management.

access_boundary_rule.description: Defines which resources and permissions are allowed.
access_boundary_rule.security_impact: Prevents users from accessing unauthorized resources.
access_boundary_rule.rationale: We use this to enforce least privilege access in GCP.

available_resource.description: The GCP resource that is allowed.
available_resource.security_impact: Restricts access to only approved projects or resources.
available_resource.rationale: Avoids access to wrong or sensitive projects.

available_permissions.security_impact: Prevents giving full admin access accidentally.
available_permissions.rationale: We only allow required permissions instead of full access.

availability_condition.description: Extra condition to control when access is allowed.
availability_condition.security_impact: Adds extra safety like time-based or condition-based access control.
availability_condition.rationale: Used to restrict access under specific conditions only.

compliant.title: Time limit
compliant.description: Access allowed only before expiry date
